rules.pass: The relay has at least its configured minimum network reach in peers.
rules.warn: The relay has some peers, but fewer than the minimum network reach in its configuration.
rules.unknown: The peer list or the configuration could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.none: The relay has no peers. Check that the P2P port is open (net.reachable) and that `peers.json` lists reachable seeds. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#peers-count.
advice.few: The relay has {peers} peers and wants at least {wanted}. Check that the P2P port is open (net.reachable) and that `peers.json` lists reachable seeds. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#peers-count.

rules.pass: The relay is within 2 blocks of the median height of its peers.
rules.warn: The relay is 3 to 52 blocks behind, or more than 2 ahead of, its peers, or it is far behind and has not yet finished its first sync, or the log cannot say whether it has.
rules.fail: The relay is 53 blocks or more behind its peers' median height, and it had caught up since its last start.
rules.unknown: No peer reported a height, or the relay's own height could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.close: The relay is level with its peers, within {blocks} blocks, at height {height}.
advice.ahead: The relay, at height {height}, is {blocks} blocks ahead of its peers' median. It may be on a fork of its own. See sync.forks and the relay's log. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#peers-height.
advice.behind: The relay is {blocks} blocks behind its peers, at height {height}. It may be stuck on a fork or unable to download. See sync.forks and the relay's log. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#peers-height.
advice.first-sync: The relay is {blocks} blocks behind its peers, at height {height}, and has not finished its first sync since it started. Wait for it to catch up. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#peers-height.
advice.far-behind: The relay is {blocks} blocks behind its peers, at height {height}, after it had caught up. It may be stuck on a fork or unable to download. See sync.forks and the relay's log. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#peers-height.

rules.pass: No network holds more than half of the relay's public peers.
rules.warn: One network (a /24 for IPv4, a /48 for IPv6) holds more than half of the relay's public peers.
rules.skipped: The relay has fewer than 4 public peers, or none: loopback, private, link-local and shared-space peers do not count.
rules.unknown: The peer list could not be read.

advice.skipped-few: The relay has {public} public peers, too few to judge how varied they are.
advice.shared: {largest} of the relay's {public} public peers share one network. A node that sees only one network is easier to isolate. Add seeds from other providers. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#peers-diversity.
advice.spread: The relay's {public} public peers come from different networks.
